# AGENTS.md — 02-terminal-portfolio

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Alex Kern**, developer portfolio, style "Retro CRT terminal".
- Stack: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JS. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `content.js` — all copy (EN + RU), projects, career log, skills, command output
- `main.js` — terminal engine, renderers, language/theme switch
- `styles.css` — tokens + themes at the top
- `index.html` — page skeleton

## How to run
- `open index.html   # or any static server: npx serve .`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: A working command line: help, projects, theme, lang, history, Tab completion.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- One font, one weight family. No images — ASCII and box-drawing only.
- Every section starts with a prompt line (`alex@kern:~$ command`).
- Three themes (green, amber, ice) are defined only via CSS variables — add new ones the same way.
- The CRT layer (scanlines, vignette, glow) must stay subtle; turn it off in reduced-motion mode.
- Keep the terminal usable without a mouse.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
